Market roadmap Tier 1 feature 1. Shared matching contract in
lib/utils/mute_filter.dart (trim/lowercase/dedupe, 50 terms x 64 chars,
commas split terms) enforced at three points: the feed screen filter
(Saved tab exempt), the worker's GET /articles via a clamped mute= param,
and the push fan-out via preferences.mutedTerms in the subscription row.
Managed from Settings > Feed Settings; add/remove re-POSTs the push
subscription. Includes market roadmap + implementation plan docs, en/hi
l10n, and unit/widge…
subject: feat(mute-filters): hide feed articles matching muted keywords

body:
Two places read and JSON-decoded the whole local store for facts they
already had or never needed.

Cold launch read the feed twice. splash preloads the article and saved
tables into ArticleRepository's process snapshot; the feed screen then
went back to StorageService and re-read both tables, decoding every
multi-KB payload a second time. At the 500-article default that is
1,540 decodes where 520 suffice (3,080 vs 1,040 at the 1,000-row cap).
_loadData now sources both lists through the repository, the …
subject: perf(local reads) and fix(settings): stop redundant local decoding

body:
Three ways to verify the app without an emulator, a Cloudflare account
or network:

- workers/dev-server.mjs serves the real worker over local HTTP with an
  in-memory KV and a seeded feed sized like the live cache, so the actual
  code path runs anywhere.
- tool/api-contract.sh: 29 curl checks over routes, methods, filters,
  pagination, both authority levels and the admin source override.
- tool/api-kv-ops.mjs and tool/api-ab.mjs measure KV round-trips per
  request and A/B the committed worker against…
subject: test(api,device): add API contracts, latency harnesses and an e2e suite

body:
Curated Feeds has no tablet layout, and the android-7 / android-10 decks
referenced phone captures, so any export from them would have been letterboxed
phone art. Remove both decks from the project state; the editor still offers
the Android tablet devices as a choice. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] and
docs/store-screenshots.md updated.
subject: chore(screenshots): drop the unused Android tablet decks

body:
First OTA release. 1.0.1 was tagged but never published to GitHub
Releases, so releases/latest returned 404 and no installed app could
ever see an update (audit I-7). Carries the audit remediation (data
loss, entitlement, worker, OTA throttle) plus the feed app bar
de-clutter.

Tag version must be strictly newer than what users run: sideload users
are on 1.0.0, Play users on 1.0.0+26, so 1.0.2 clears both.
subject: chore: release 1.0.2

build_signed/release failed closed on missing FLUTTER_COMMIT before doing
any work. The SHA is now pinned in config (verified upstream tag SHA for
3.47.2) with the env var kept as an override, so the gate stays fail-closed
without requiring a dashboard visit. Documented as optional in releasing.md.
subject: fix(ci): self-contained SDK provenance fallback so signed builds run without dashboard env
